title: Water Damage Mitigation Credit Desk Memo: Past-Due Mold Remediation Balance and the Drying Deposit
content:
**Credit desk memo — Water Damage Mitigation drying deposit and Mold Remediation balances**

A customer whose invoiced mold remediation job with the company is past due pays a larger drying deposit: when the balance due on the customer's Mold Remediation job in invoiced status is above zero and today is more than 60 days after that job's payment due date, a credit multiplier of 1.5 applies to the drying estimate; when that balance due is above zero and today is 1 to 60 days after the payment due date, a credit multiplier of 1.25 applies; in any other case, including a customer with no invoiced mold remediation job, no credit multiplier applies. When the customer holds more than one mold remediation job in invoiced status, the drying deposit is set by a human representative.

## Records read
The customer's Mold Remediation jobs: the job in invoiced status, its balance due and its payment due date, compared with today's date in calendar days.

## Boundary table (hypothetical payment due date of August 1)
| Mold Remediation job in invoiced status | Today | Credit multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| balance due above zero | August 1 (0 days after) | none |
| balance due above zero | August 2 (1 day after) | 1.25 |
| balance due above zero | September 30 (60 days after) | 1.25 |
| balance due above zero | October 1 (61 days after) | 1.5 |
| balance due zero | any | none |
| no invoiced Mold Remediation job | any | none |
| two or more in invoiced status | any | the drying deposit is set by a human representative |
